blurb: Melton Hill Marina offers year-round boat slips with utilities and on-site fueling, guest boat slips for short stays, pontoon boat rentals, and lakeside lodging options including the Lake View Chalet and Lake View Loft. Guests can fish from the shore or dock and enjoy easy access to local events and fishing spots. Pontoon rentals require an experienced operator over 21 and are available in flexible time sessions.
